rows.grounds: compound bhava-bandha-ātmaka 'consisting of existence-bond'; instrumental plural

items.question: What truth must be known to be freed from the bond of existence?
premises: Knowledge of this truth frees from existence-bond.
The verse addresses the goddess as beloved.
items.inference: Knowing this truth liberates from bhava-bandha.
uncertainties: Instrumental plural gender of the compound is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: Having known this truth, O goddess, O beloved, one is freed from bonds consisting of existence.
